record.dic_text:
04992 Mattattah {mat-tat-taw'}

用於 04993; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Mattathah 1; 1

瑪達他 = "耶和華的禮物"
1) 哈順的眾子之一, 以斯拉時代的人, 他被迫要與其外邦妻子
   離婚 (#拉 10:33|)
record.edic_text:
04992 Mattattah {mat-tat-taw'}

for 04993;; n pr m

AV - Mattathah 1; 1

Mattathah = "gift of Jehovah"
1) son of Hashum who took and put away his foreign wife in the time
   of Ezra
